title: Binary Model Export
subTitle: Binary conversion function for external utilization of Dymola models
introduction:
Binary Model Export is a feature that allows system models developed in Dymola to be exported as binaries in the form of independent executable files. By utilizing this option, Modelica-based simulation models can be converted into standard formats such as FMU (Functional Mock-up Unit) as well as separate binary files, enabling free distribution within an organization or to customers and partners.
The exported binary models can be executed independently without Dymola or other software. Since users can directly set access permissions for internal model variables and parameters, it is advantageous for protecting intellectual property (IP). Additionally, it supports FMU conversion for interoperation with external platforms such as Simulink, allowing the same model to be utilized across various simulation environments.
